note: The app's backlog as the product team wrote it. Seeds the Jira simulator; a test keeps it equal to the stories the demo app serves.

stories.title: Cart totals are always correct
stories.criteria:
A line total is the price times the quantity.
The subtotal is the sum of the line totals.
A discount never exceeds the subtotal.
Tax is 8% of (subtotal - discount), rounded to the nearest cent.
The total is subtotal - discount + shipping + tax.

stories.title: Each coupon applies once
stories.criteria:
Applying a coupon that is already in the cart is rejected or leaves the discount unchanged.
The cart never lists the same coupon twice.
An unknown coupon code is rejected with a message.

stories.title: Quantities and stock are respected
stories.criteria:
A quantity below 1 is rejected.
A shopper cannot add more of a product than is in stock.

stories.title: Search ignores letter case
stories.criteria: Searching returns every product whose name contains the term, ignoring letter case.

stories.title: Checkout validates the payment card
stories.criteria:
A card whose expiry date (MM/YY) is in the past is rejected.
A card number that fails the Luhn check is rejected.

stories.title: Orders can be cancelled until they ship
stories.criteria:
A shopper can cancel their own order while it is Processing.
An order that is Shipped or Delivered cannot be cancelled.
Cancelling returns the items to stock.

stories.title: Staff manage orders
stories.criteria:
Only staff can see all orders and change an order's status.
An order goes from Processing to Shipped to Delivered, in that order.

stories.title: The listed price is the price charged
stories.criteria: A product's price in the cart is the price shown for it in the product list.
